shots.say: Tula lives in the sea. How does a sea turtle breathe?
Does she breathe the water? Or something else?
I'm Milo the bluebird. Let's find Tula's breathing secrets!
The Animated Zoo!
Tula has three breathing secrets. Let's find them, one by one!
Breathing secret number one! Can a sea turtle breathe under the water?
Yes, it can? Or no, it can't?
No! A sea turtle cannot breathe under the water.
It has no gills, so it cannot take air from the water.
A sea turtle is not a fish. It is a reptile!
A sea turtle is a reptile. It breathes air, just like you!
Just like other reptiles, a sea turtle has lungs.
Its lungs are right under its shell. Look! In, and out.
When Tula breathes in, her lungs fill up with air. When she breathes out, the air goes out.
Wow! Lungs, under a shell!
Put your hand on your chest. Breathe in, and out, nice and slow.
Breathe in with me. One, two, three. And out!
What does a sea turtle need, to breathe?
Air! Up here, above the water.
Say it with me. A sea turtle breathes air!
Now take a big, slow breath, like Tula. In, and out!
Quick check! Does a sea turtle have gills? Yes, or no?
No gills! Great job!
Breathing secret number two! Where does a sea turtle go, to breathe air?
Up to the top of the water? Or down to the sand?
Up to the top! Sea turtles must come up to the top, to breathe.
Look up! Can you see the sky? That is where the air is.
Look! Tula pops her head out of the water, and takes a breath.
Breathe in! The air goes into her lungs.
Then she swims back down again.
How many times does Tula pop up? Count with me! One, two, three!
Green sea turtles eat seagrass and algae. Munch, munch! Yummy!
Tula eats under the water. But she always comes back up, to breathe.
Then up she swims, for air!
Look up, way up high, where the air is!
Swim up like Tula, and pop your head up! Pop!
Say it with me. A sea turtle swims up to breathe!
Can you paddle your arms like flippers? Paddle, paddle!
Quick check! When Tula needs air, does she swim up? Or does she stay down?
Up! Super swimming!
Breathing secret number three! How long can a resting sea turtle hold its breath?
Just a few seconds? Or for hours?
For hours! A resting sea turtle can hold its breath, for hours!
That is a long, long time!
When it swims and looks for food, it comes up more often.
And look! Sea turtles can even sleep, under the water!
Tula is resting under a rock. Sleepy, sleepy turtle.
Let's be very quiet, and let Tula rest.
How does Tula save her air?
Her heart beats very, very slowly. That saves her air!
Count the slow beats with me. One, and two.
Her heart beats slowly, so her air lasts a long time.
Can you tap slowly, like Tula's heart? Tap, and tap, and tap.
Say it with me. A sea turtle can hold its breath, for a long time!
Rest your head on your hands, like a sleepy sea turtle. Night, night!
Quick check! Can a sea turtle sleep under the water? Yes, or no?
Yes! You remembered!
Three breathing secrets! Now it is quiz time!
What does a sea turtle breathe? Water, or air?
Air! With its lungs.
Where does Tula go for air? Up to the top, or down to the sand?
Up to the top! Pop!
Can a resting sea turtle hold its breath for hours? Yes, or no?
Yes! For hours and hours.
Tula breathes air, she swims up to the top, and she can hold her breath for a long time. You found all three secrets!
Breathe in and out. Pop your head up. And tap slowly, like Tula's heart!
Next time: can a turtle leave its shell? Bye-bye, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
